+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+import threading
+from queue import Queue
+from unittest.mock import call
+
+from ansible.executor.task_queue_manager import DisplaySend, FinalQueue
+from ansible.plugins.strategy import StrategySentinel, results_thread_main
+
+
+def test_final_queue_sends_display_arguments(mocker):
+    queue = FinalQueue()
+    put = mocker.patch.object(queue, 'put')
+
+    queue.send_display(u'message', 'red', stderr=True, newline=False)
+
+    event = put.call_args[0][0]
+    assert isinstance(event, DisplaySend)
+    assert event.args == (u'message', 'red')
+    assert event.kwargs == {'stderr': True, 'newline': False}
+    assert put.call_args[1] == {'block': False}
+    queue.close()
+
+
+def test_results_thread_displays_all_queued_messages(mocker):
+    queue = Queue()
+    strategy = mocker.Mock()
+    strategy._final_q = queue
+    display = mocker.patch('ansible.plugins.strategy.display.display')
+    queue.put(DisplaySend(u'first', stderr=True))
+    queue.put(DisplaySend(u'second', newline=False))
+    queue.put(StrategySentinel())
+
+    thread = threading.Thread(target=results_thread_main, args=(strategy,))
+    thread.start()
+    thread.join(timeout=2)
+
+    assert not thread.is_alive()
+    assert display.call_args_list == [call(u'first', stderr=True),
+                                      call(u'second', newline=False)]

+def test_display_parent_uses_lock(mocker):

+    mocker.patch.object(display, '_lock', lock)
